overloads.semanticRole: Imports and displays the document at filePath into the 4D View Pro area vpAreaName, replacing any existing content.

constraints: vpAreaName must name an existing 4D View Pro area; an unknown name raises an error.
The imported document replaces any data already present in the area.
Supported filePath extensions: .4vp (4D View Pro), .xlsx (Excel), .txt/.csv (UTF-8 text), .sjs (SpreadJS); an unrecognized extension is treated as a text document.
filePath must be a full path unless the document sits alongside the Project folder, in which case just its name may be passed.
An error is returned if filePath is invalid or the file is missing or malformed.
paramObj.formula is an optional 4D.Function callback invoked when the import completes.
